label: Roadway fragility on permanent ground displacement

inputs.name: pgd
inputs.description: The component's permanent ground displacement, in m, from its own mechanism.

outputs.name: open
outputs.description: Whether the road stays open at the component, on its mechanism's quantity.

pgd.description: The displacement quantity the curve reads.

closing_state.description: The damage state at or above which the road counts as closed: a Hazus roadway state, or impassable for a curve fitted directly to whether traffic could pass.

window_h.description: The hours after the shock that closed refers to (e.g. 72 for the relief window), where the curve was fitted to closures over a stated time; left out for a Hazus damage-state curve.

source.note: Each parameter set cites its curve.

description: P(road closed | PGD) = Phi(ln(PGD / median) / beta) for the closing state; 0 at PGD = 0. The parameter set is chosen by the row's kind and road_class: a Hazus HRD1 or HRD2 curve on that mechanism's quantities (hazus61.road.{kind}.{road_class}), or a curve of its own, e.g. for fault offset (road.fault-offset.{road_class}).
